verified_facts: The repository is public and exposes an RSA/CTF command-line tool.
The README documents RSA key/cipher analysis, targeted and multi-key attacks, partial-prime wildcard recovery, Cargo and Docker usage.
The README documents a rug/GMP dependency and an MSYS2 requirement for Windows builds.
